newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: SAIC to run Venezuela oil company communication.
newsitem.headline: SAIC to run Venezuela oil company communication.

text.p: Science Applications International Corp (SAIC) has won a bidding round to run information systems at Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA), an oil industry official said Thursday.
"PDVSA auctioned the service between various companies and chose SAIC which will form a mixed company with PDVSA and take a 51 percent stake," said the official, who asked not to be named.
The auction for the information system forms part of PDVSA's strategy to out-source non-core activities.
"The aim is for the company to start operating on Jan 1 but it could be any time in the first quarter," the official said.
The mixed company will handle all of PDVSA's information services within Venezuela.
"PDVSA has very modern equipment but the system requires constant investment," the official said.
Employee-owned SAIC provides high technology products and services to government and private companies.
With annual revenues exceeding $2.2 billion, SAIC and its subsidiaries have 22,000 employees in more than 475 locations worldwide.
